build_cmds: cmake -S . -B build -DBUILD_CONFIG=mysql_release -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr/local/mysql -DINSTALL_LAYOUT=STANDALONE -DREPRODUCIBLE_BUILD=ON '-DCOMPILATION_COMMENT=ReadyStack build of MySQL Community Server (GPL)' '-DCOMPILATION_COMMENT_SERVER=ReadyStack build of MySQL Community Server (GPL)' -DWITH_SSL=system -DWITH_ZLIB=system -DWITH_ZSTD=system -DWITH_LZ4=system -DWITH_ICU=system -DWITH_PROTOBUF=bundled -DWITH_EDITLINE=bundled -DWITH_TIRPC=bundled -DWITH_CURL=none -DWITH_FIDO=none -DWITH_AUTHENTICATION_LDAP=OFF -DWITH_AUTHENTICATION_KERBEROS=OFF -DWITH_AUTHENTICATION_WEBAUTHN=OFF -DWITH_AUTHENTICATION_CLIENT_PLUGINS=OFF -DWITH_ROUTER=OFF -DWITH_UNIT_TESTS=OFF -DWITH_NDB=OFF -DWITHOUT_NDBCLUSTER_STORAGE_ENGINE=ON -DWITH_SYSTEMD=OFF -DWITH_NUMA=OFF -DWITHOUT_THREAD_POOL=1 -DINSTALL_MYSQLTESTDIR= -DINSTALL_STATIC_LIBRARIES=OFF

J=$(nproc); M=$(awk '/MemAvailable/ {print int($2/2097152)}' /proc/meminfo); [ "$M" -ge 1 ] || M=1; [ "$M" -lt "$J" ] && J=$M; echo "compiling with $J parallel jobs"; cmake --build build --parallel "$J"

cmake --install build --component Test --prefix /tmp/test-component && (cd /tmp/test-component && find . \( -type f -o -type l \) -print0) | (cd /usr/local/mysql && xargs -0 -r rm -f) && rm -rf /tmp/test-component
source._note: BUILD_CONFIG=mysql_release is upstream's release profile (cmake/build_configurations/mysql_release.cmake): it turns on REPRODUCIBLE_BUILD for release build types and requires libaio. COMPILATION_COMMENT is set so @@version_comment names this build instead of Oracle's own 'MySQL Community Server - GPL' string. WITH_TIRPC=bundled still needs rpcgen (rpcsvc-proto). libaio-dev: InnoDB native AIO (mysql_release refuses to configure without it). The Test install component (test plugins and components, mysqltest) is installed into a scratch prefix only to learn its file list, which is then removed from /usr/local/mysql. INSTALL_MYSQLTESTDIR= keeps the 740 MB mysql-test tree out of the image.
